meta.doesNotMeasure: Time to first token. Streaming is not implemented (no stream:true, ReadableStream or streamText in src/), so CP1 §3.2.4 'first text token under 2 seconds' is NOT EVALUABLE against this implementation.
meta.environmentCaveat: Latency is dominated by network round-trip and third-party provider queueing, not by project code. These figures characterise THIS machine and network only, and are not portable to a laptop, a different region, or a deployed host.

results.reason: Requires a representative inspiration image as input. No fixture image is committed to the repository, and generating a synthetic one would not represent real usage.
